assets/js/app.js.description: Alpine.js store pattern with persistence: Uses Alpine.$persist([]).as('store_name') for local storage. Wishlist store (lines 47-220) is the reference implementation with methods: has(), toggle(), add(), remove(), clear(), count getter. Events dispatched: wishlist:added, wishlist:removed, wishlist:cleared. Exposed via window.Moderna object for template access.

product.html.twig.description: Product page has all data needed for recently viewed tracking: product.id, product.i18ns.title, product.publicUrl, initialImageId, taxedPrice, taxedPromoPrice, currentPse.promo. wishlistButton component at line 329 shows exact data structure pattern to follow.

wishlist.html.twig.description: Reference for displaying products from Alpine store: uses x-data with Alpine functions, template x-for loops, product cards with responsive grid. wishlistPage() and productSuggestions() Alpine components show patterns for loading items and reactive updates.

./assets/js/app.js.description: Implemented recentlyViewed Alpine store following the established wishlist pattern. The store uses Alpine.$persist for localStorage persistence with key 'moderna_recently_viewed'. Key features include: duplicate product handling (updates viewedAt timestamp and moves to front), maxItems limit enforcement (12 products), sorted getAll() method, and comprehensive event dispatching (recentlyviewed:added, removed, cleared).
